# tag-pattern

Require tags to match a configured regular expression.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | `{"pattern":"^@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$"}` |

Requires tag names to match a regular expression.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "tag-pattern": ["error", {"pattern":"^@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$"}] } }
```
